contract.coordinate_frame: KBDU local AEQD; Unity +X east, +Y up, +Z north
contract.far_handoff: 2020 orthophoto; no individual geometry below useful projected size
contract.geometry: overlapping individual crown/trunk LODs; no opaque grove hull

limitations: RGB orthophoto segmentation is semantic placement evidence, not an individual-tree survey.
Full-map height uses bounded visual allometry outside the retained near-airport lidar zone.
Raw orthophotos and downloaded high-poly reference assets remain external and uncommitted.

processing.color_method: robust median of the brighter source-canopy samples to avoid double-baked shadow
processing.height_method: terrain grounded; bounded Boulder crown-height allometry because full-map surveyed canopy height is unavailable
processing.placement_method: connected-canopy segmentation with deterministic mask-constrained blue-noise centers
processing.semantic_method: RGB vegetation/texture segmentation plus authoritative building-footprint stem exclusion
